# Jac-It House Leveling & Foundation Repair

> Providing dependable foundation repair and house leveling services across Deep East Texas for over 25 years.

## About Us
Jac-It House Leveling & Foundation Repair is a professional service providing foundation solutions in the Deep East Texas region. With over 25 years of experience, we specialize in repairing and securing properties with lasting results. We are a BBB Accredited Business.

## Services
- Pier & Beam Repair
- Foundation Repair
- House Leveling
- Press Piers
- Slab Repair
- Foam Injection
- Drainage Solutions

## Service Areas
We serve East Texas and Deep East Texas. Each city below has a dedicated page covering local soil
conditions, common foundation warning signs and the services we run there:

- [Tyler, TX](/locations/tyler-tx) — Smith County. Sandy loam over dense clay on rolling iron-ore ridges; erosion and washout rather than clay swell.
- [Longview, TX](/locations/longview-tx) — Gregg County. 1930s oil-boom pier and beam housing stock on soils with a high water table.
- [Lufkin, TX](/locations/lufkin-tx) — Angelina County. Heavy Piney Woods rainfall, sand perched over tight clay, and pine root moisture loss.
- [Nacogdoches, TX](/locations/nacogdoches-tx) — Nacogdoches County. Redland clay loam, real topography, and historic homes on original piers.
- [Henderson, TX](/locations/henderson-tx) — Rusk County. Rural acreage homes and owner-built additions on separate footings.
- [Jacksonville, TX](/locations/jacksonville-tx) — Cherokee County. Cut-and-fill hillside homesites along the Love's Lookout ridges.
- [Palestine, TX](/locations/palestine-tx) — Anderson County. Expansive clay shrink-swell and Victorian-era shallow pier foundations.
- [Marshall, TX](/locations/marshall-tx) — Harrison County. Red clay uplands under 1800s architecture on shallow original piers.
- [Livingston, TX](/locations/livingston-tx) — Polk County. Saturated lake and bottomland soils under waterfront and seasonal property.
- [Huntsville, TX](/locations/huntsville-tx) — Walker County. A soil transition zone where sandy uplands and clay pockets sit a street apart.

We also serve surrounding communities including Whitehouse, Bullard, Lindale, Kilgore, White Oak,
Gladewater, Hallsville, Diboll, Hudson, Huntington, Appleby, Garrison, Tatum, Overton, Rusk, Alto,
Elkhart, Frankston, Grapeland, Waskom, Jefferson, Onalaska, Corrigan, New Waverly and Willis.
